tax.text: Strong says he is pro-growth and wants to cut government spending and return money to families and workers.
tax.quote: It's time to put money back in the pockets of American families and workers and right-size wasteful government spending.

safety.text: Strong, a former first responder, says he will work to give law enforcement more tools and resources.
safety.quote: I will always seek ways to equip our law enforcement officials with the necessary tools and resources to carry out their duties safely.

immigration.text: Strong backed impeaching DHS Secretary Mayorkas, saying he refused to enforce federal immigration law.
immigration.quote: Mayorkas has willfully refused to comply with and enforce federal immigration law as passed by Congress

guns.text: Strong, a lifetime NRA member, pledges to oppose any effort to limit gun owners' rights.
guns.quote: I will always fight any attempt by the radical left to diminish the right of law-abiding American citizens to keep and bear arms.

abortion.text: Strong describes defending life as a solemn duty and frames it among his core values.
abortion.quote: I view it as my solemn duty to defend life, stand for your right to worship, and preserve our commonsense values.

wages.text: His labor platform pledges to protect organized labor and defend the right to collective bargaining for workers.
wages.quote: Fight for the right to collective bargaining for workers

trade.text: Sneed lists repealing tariffs among his affordability priorities, saying rollbacks would lower costs for working-class Alabamians.

debt.text: Sneed says he opposes cuts to Social Security and Medicaid while also saying the national debt should be reduced.
debt.quote: Sneed does not support cuts to Medicaid, Social Security or the VA, but he believes there is a need to reduce the national debt.

housing.text: Sneed proposes expanding rental assistance and increasing affordable housing options.
housing.quote: Expand Rental Assistance Increase Affordable Housing Options Support First-Time Home Buyers

schools.text: Sneed supports increasing teacher pay and opposes the CHOOSE Act and voucher programs.
schools.quote: Oppose the "CHOOSE Act" and all voucher schemes.

immigration.text: Sneed calls for comprehensive reform, a simpler path to citizenship, and restoring asylum protections for immigrants.
immigration.quote: Our current immigration posture and enforcement practices run counter to our essential American spirit.

health.text: Sneed proposes expanding Medicaid availability and regulating for-profit insurance companies.

energy.text: His energy and environment platform calls for restoring clean air and water protections and funding clean, sustainable technologies.
energy.quote: Restore federal funding for clean, innovative, and sustainable technologies.
